svg.title: SSD - UC1: Book Appointment (success and failure scenarios)

g.text: SSD - UC1: Book Appointment (success and failure scenarios)
Precondition: user (administrative staff or patient) is identified and authenticated;
a patient booking for themselves follows the same flow
if the patient is not registered, the use case ends
[service requires a referral and patient has none active (5a - FAILURE)]
Use case ends without booking an appointment
active referrals (if the service requires one) (5b)
[patient asks to join the waitlist («extend» Join Waitlist)]
Use case ends without booking an appointment
Otherwise staff searches again, or the use case ends
[slot still available and required resources free (main)]
«extend» Allocate Resources: if the service requires resources,
the system allocates them during booking
[a required room or equipment is taken at that time (FAILURE)]
required resources unavailable for this slot
